name: sabnzbd-control
description: Full control of a SABnzbd usenet downloader (v4+ HTTP API) from Claude Code. Bundles an MCP server authenticated with a SABnzbd API key (apikey= query param), exposing both a generic passthrough reaching every /api mode and curated tools for status, version, queue, history, server stats, warnings, categories, scripts, pause/resume (whole queue or single job, confirm-gated), add-by-URL/local-file, delete/retry jobs, change job category/priority, clear history, speed limit, get/set config, test email, and shutdown/restart (heavily gated). Tested against SABnzbd 5.0.4.
